exposure: Neonates with PDA vs. neonates with closed arterial ducts on day 7
cohort: 50 preterm neonates with patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) admitted to Afzalipour hospital in 2017-2018.
finding: Preterm neonates with PDA had significantly lower platelet counts and higher CRP levels on day 7 compared to day 3.
